description: A named scarce resource: the browser cap admits only one e2e step at a time, while ordinary unit tests still run in parallel.

steps.description: Compile the web app before any end-to-end flow can run.
Login flow. Demands the browser resource, so it serializes against checkout.
Checkout flow. Also needs the browser; waits until login releases it.

steps.desc: unit tests (no browser; free to run in parallel)
steps.description: Unit tests. No browser demand, so they run alongside whichever e2e step holds it.
